description: Defines template structures and classes for array traits, iterators, and comparison operators within the android::ftl::details namespace, including utility functions for array manipulation.

classes.name: ArrayTraits
classes.description: Template struct providing type definitions and static methods for array element construction, replacement, swapping, and copying.

classes.name: ArrayIterators
classes.description: CRTP mixin class providing iterator access functions for array-like classes.

classes.name: ArrayComparators
classes.description: Template struct defining comparison operators for array-like classes.

methods.name: construct_at
methods.description: Constructs an object at a given iterator position, using variadic arguments.

methods.name: replace_at
methods.description: Replaces the element at a given iterator position with a new value.

methods.name: in_place_swap_ranges
methods.description: Swaps ranges of elements between two iterators.

methods.name: uninitialized_copy
methods.description: Copies elements from a source range to an uninitialized destination.
